title: How This "Boring" YouTube Channel Gets 16M Views a Month
transcript: This channel got 16 million views last month. His secret isn't beating YouTube's algorithm, it's beating Google's. When someone types a problem into Google, his video shows up. People click, they watch, and it happens every single day because his topics never grow old. The result, view charts that climb day after day, month after month, leading to compounding growth. Compare that to a viral hit, one huge spike, and the video is dead. And let's be real, most videos won't even get that spike. So, while this channel looks boring on [music] the surface, he's not gambling on shocked faces and clickbait. He's making tutorials on the exact things people are already searching for. And those videos rank in both Google and YouTube, sending views straight to his channel and dollars to his bank.
